Meeting Date:                 4/27/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Scott, Jr. (24)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 4-1 at 1251 S Kedzie Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                        ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO-
SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe B3-3,
Community Shopping District symbols and Indications as shown on Map No. 4-1 in the
area bound by:

      a line 75 feet north of and parallel to West 13'" Street; the alley next east of and parallel
      to South Kedzie Avenue; a line 50 feet north of and parallel to West 13'" Street; and
      South Kedzie Avenue,

to those of a B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                            Mfchael Scott Jr.
                                                            Alderman, 24*" Ward




Common Address:
1251 S. Kedzie Avenue
